title: DNS Record Guard
description: Stops a DNS edit or delete from quietly breaking things by checking it against the whole zone before saving: email that stops (a removed MX, SPF senders dropped or doubled past the 10-lookup limit, a DKIM selector removed, escalated when the DMARC policy enforces it), a CNAME at the root or beside other records and names left pointing at nothing, then saying how long the change takes to spread with a one-tap “lower TTL first” that counts down until old caches clear.
stops: Deleted MX record stopped company email
